title: CPU recency advice traded a small replay-rate gain for latency costs
summary: Exact recorded-output serving replay established a small throughput gain while saving 56 MiB of GPU cache capacity. It did not establish a general interactive-latency or generation-quality benefit.
scope: Twelve fresh matched workflow pairs, 1,728 exact requests, three fixed traces; Qwen2.5-7B-AWQ FP16 on RTX 2080 Ti/WSL2. Candidate 2,048 GPU blocks versus ARC 2,112; equal CPU capacity.
limitations: Recorded-output replay is not free generation. Earlier pilots and failed confirmation are excluded from the fresh estimate and retained in the source. Latency regressions limit adoption.
decision: Keep as evidence that simple recency advice can matter; assess latency and useful work separately when developing it.

chart.caption: Original whole-workflow paired Student-t 95% intervals, conditional on three traces. Higher is better.
